callback_smoke.title: Confirm the invite path binds correctly
callback_smoke.verification_command: # a human with a browser; no local command

database.title: Apply migrations to the runtime database, to head 0030
database.verification_command: uv run alembic current 2>/tmp/nf_alembic_current.err | tail -1; echo stderr=/tmp/nf_alembic_current.err

database.title: Re-run the RLS isolation proof against the migrated database

do_not_do.title: Do not leave X-NF-Org-Id enabled alongside live customer auth
do_not_do.verification_command: # an unauthenticated header that sets app.current_org_id is a cross-tenant read waiting to happen

do_not_do.title: Do not use tenant_id as an RLS authority
Do not use customer_org_id as an RLS authority
do_not_do.verification_command: # it is a label; it has no foreign key

do_not_do.title: Do not use organization_profile_id as an organization_id
do_not_do.verification_command: # a real value from a real column in the wrong identity space

do_not_do.title: Do not insert a verified binding without a real verifier identity
do_not_do.verification_command: # ck_nf_binding_verified_needs_verifier refuses it, and the workflow refuses before the database does

do_not_do.title: Do not sign a production session with the committed fixture key
do_not_do.verification_command: # the fixture key is disqualified by source, not by length

environment_variables.title: Set OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_CLIENT_ID and OIDC_AUDIENCE
environment_variables.verification_command: uv run python -c "from nativeforge.services.customer_auth_environment_preflight_service import build_environment_preflight as b; print(b()['provider_env_missing_keys'])"

environment_variables.title: Supply OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET from a secret manager
Supply NF_SESSION_SIGNING_KEY from an environment or secret manager
Set NF_PUBLIC_ORIGIN to the origin browsers actually reach

provider_console.title: Create the application in the provider console
Register the redirect URI, matching a route that can consume it
provider_console.verification_command: uv run python -c "from nativeforge.services.customer_auth_provider_readiness_service import build_provider_readiness as b; print(b()['callback_route_matches_redirect_uri'])"

provider_console.title: Validate the issuer JWKS once, deliberately, under review
provider_console.verification_command: # the only step that touches the network; run under review

role_mapping.title: Define roles in the provider console
Map every provider role explicitly; unknown roles grant nothing
role_mapping.verification_command: uv run python -c "from nativeforge.services.customer_auth_role_mapping_service import ROLES; print(sorted(ROLES))"

rollback.title: Rotate NF_SESSION_SIGNING_KEY if a session may have leaked
rollback.verification_command: # a signed session cannot be revoked before it expires - rotating the key invalidates every outstanding session at once

rollback.title: Revoke any verified binding created in error - never delete one
rollback.verification_command: # Gate 120's revoke_binding is an UPDATE; the row and its history stay

rollback.title: Remove the redirect URI from the provider console

security.title: Replace X-NF-Org-Id across every route module, then disable it
security.verification_command: uv run python -c "from nativeforge.services.dev_org_header_shutdown_readiness_service import build_dev_header_shutdown_readiness as b; r=b(); print(r['dev_header_used_by_routes'], r['safe_to_disable_now'])"

security.title: Confirm the session cookie policy is production safe
security.verification_command: uv run python -c "from nativeforge.services.customer_session_cookie_policy_service import build_session_cookie_policy as b; print(b()['production_safe'])"

verified_binding.title: Confirm a verified OIDC subject exists to name as the verifier
verified_binding.verification_command: uv run python -c "from nativeforge.services.verified_binding_workflow_service import run_binding_workflow as w; print(w(operation='inspect_pending')['customer_auth_live'])"

verified_binding.title: Create the first verified binding through the Gate 120 workflow
verified_binding.verification_command: uv run python -c "from nativeforge.services.tenant_customer_org_binding_repository_service import list_bindings_for_organization as l; print('repository ready')"
